exact_sharing_measurement.scope: Exact value DAG sharing measurement; not a whole-kernel equivalence proof.

remaining_contracts: Unconsumed get from uninitialized scratch is rejected before algebra lowering.
All nine local kernel outputs need defined active lanes; dropping three ports in the parent does not remove the local obligation.
Non-default dot precision, including equal HIGHEST policies on both sides, is not admitted to the algebra converter.

The original NT=3/CHUNK_BATCH=2 db tail DMA reads 16 uninitialized rows that the launcher later discards. Public output selection alone cannot bypass the current active-DMA-source definedness contract.
